en: That LBX Joker Mk-2 used by Daiki Sendo in Artemis.
Introducing as a Premium Bandai exclusive item! !
A custom version of the Joker used by Daiki Sendo in Artemis.
The characteristic coloring and head parts are faithfully reproduced (new head parts).
The face is a new Seal exclusively for Mk-2, reproducing a suspicious expression!
A special stand is included that allows you to express agile movements.
Assembly type platform model
Target age: 6 years old and above
Product material: PS/PE
No glue used for assembly
